Models from your Antigravity conversations are now recorded too, with effort and tier suffixes removed so each model is announced once. Antigravity models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

**A stale-data warning no longer pushes the Settings button out of the panel.** When Claude and Codex are hidden, the Settings button moves to the Antigravity, Grok, or Muse card, and that card's "about N minutes ago" warning pushed it past the card's edge. On the card that holds the button, the warning now shows only its icons and the age moves into the ⓘ tooltip; the Antigravity title shortens if needed. The tooltip now starts with the age on every card. Reported in #341.

**New models from Claude Code and other tools are now noticed on Windows too.** The Windows tray left out the models found in your usage logs when it recorded seen models, so quota-aware mode on Windows only announced new Codex models and Antigravity quota groups. Models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: --attach 憑證檢查延後至上傳端點並由伺服器裁定 GitHub App 權限
title.en: Defer `--attach` Credential Checks to Upload Endpoint and Let Server Arbitrate GitHub App Permissions

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程中使用 GitHub CLI 發布內容時，若想隨附測試日誌或建置成品，通常會使用 `--attach` 參數打包檔案。⟦就像去快遞站寄送特殊包裹，以前臨櫃店員只要在清單上找不到對應代號就當場拒收，現在門市先將包裹轉交後端物流中心，由總部依照權限統一核對資格。⟧過去命令列工具會在終端機本機端提前檢查身分，容易直接攔下自動化工具的上傳請求。現在 GitHub CLI 將 `--attach` 的憑證檢查延後到上傳端點處理。GitHub 伺服器端會直接裁定哪些 GitHub App 的安裝權杖（token，向伺服器驗證身分的授權令牌）具備附加檔案的權限。使用 GitHub App 執行排程任務時，能否附加檔案，改由 GitHub 伺服器裁定；`--attach` 的憑證檢查則延後到上傳端點處理。
body.en: When publishing content in automated workflows using GitHub CLI, if you want to include test logs or build artifacts, you typically use the `--attach` flag to bundle files. ⟦Picture sending a special package at a courier station: counter clerks previously rejected parcels on the spot whenever a matching code was missing from their list, but now the station forwards packages to the backend logistics center so headquarters can centrally verify eligibility based on permissions.⟧ Previously, the command-line tool checked credentials early on the local terminal side, easily blocking upload requests from automated tools outright. Now, GitHub CLI defers `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint. The GitHub server directly arbitrates which GitHub App installation tokens (authorization credentials used to verify identity with the server) have permission to attach files. When running scheduled tasks with a GitHub App, whether files can be attached is decided by the GitHub server; `--attach` credential checks are deferred to the upload endpoint.

Allow server to arbitrate which GitHub App installation tokens can attach files by @martinajir in [#14804](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14804)
Defer `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint by @BagToad in [#14805](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14805)

title.zh-TW: `gh` 可改用會自動續期的登入憑證（預覽）
title.en: `gh` can sign in with auto-refreshing credentials (preview)

body.zh-TW:
一般用 `gh` 登入 GitHub，拿到的 token（證明你身分的授權令牌）發下來就不會過期。現在可以改選會過期的 OAuth 憑證：`gh` 會存一把短效的 access token，另配一把會輪替的 refresh token（專門用來換新令牌的憑證）。access token 需要時會自動換新，你不必重新登入。⟦公司門禁卡改成每天自動換發的臨時卡，以前一張卡用到離職，現在卡片天天換新，你照樣每天刷卡進門。⟧這是預覽功能，要自己選擇開啟。只想這一次登入用它，打：

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

想以後每次登入都優先用它，打：

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```
body.en:
Normally, signing in to GitHub with `gh` gives you a token (the pass that proves who you are) that never expires. You can now opt into expiring OAuth credentials instead: `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token (a credential used only to get a new pass). The access token is refreshed automatically whenever needed, so you stay signed in without authenticating again. ⟦An office swapped its permanent badges for temporary ones reissued every day: you used to keep one badge until you left the company, and now it renews daily while you still just tap in each morning.⟧ This is a preview you have to opt into. To use it for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

items.original:
## Expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens (preview)

`gh` can now sign in with expiring OAuth credentials that it refreshes automatically. When you opt in, `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token and refreshes the access token whenever it is needed, so you stay signed in without having to authenticate again.

To opt in for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

title.zh-TW: 用會過期的 `gh` 憑證時，查狀態、接 git 和寫腳本要注意的事
title.en: Living with expiring `gh` credentials: status, git and scripts

body.zh-TW: 開了自動續期後，想知道憑證還剩多久，就打 `gh auth status`：它會顯示憑證能不能續期、access token 何時到期。它和 `gh auth token` 都會在需要時自動續期。github.com 和 GHE.com 支援這種 token，其他主機會退回一般不過期的 token。git 走 HTTPS 的話，建議用 git 2.46 以上，並執行 `gh auth setup-git`，讓 `gh` 當 git 的 credential helper（替 git 提供登入資料的程式）。這樣 git 不會把憑證留到過期之後。⟦跟鮮奶一樣，以前能囤一箱慢慢喝，現在得隨喝隨買。⟧腳本和擴充別把 `gh auth token` 的輸出存起來，每次要用都重新執行它；透過 `GH_TOKEN` 或 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 給的 token 則永遠不會續期。
body.en: Once expiring credentials are on, you may want to know how long yours has left. `gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires, and both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` refresh the access token automatically when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token. If git talks to GitHub over HTTPS, the advice is to use git 2.46 or newer and run `gh auth setup-git` so `gh` acts as git's credential helper (the program that hands git its sign-in details). That way git does not cache the credential past its lifetime. ⟦Treat it like fresh milk: you could once stock up a crate and drink it slowly, and now you buy it as you need it.⟧ So scripts and extensions should not store the output of `gh auth token`; run it again each time a token is needed. Tokens supplied through `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` are never refreshed.

items.original:
`gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires. Both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` automatically refresh the access token when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token.

If you use HTTPS as your git protocol, we advise using git 2.46 or newer and letting `gh` act as your git credential helper by running `gh auth setup-git`. This way `gh` serves and refreshes the expiring credential for git, and git does not cache it past its lifetime.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Expiring access tokens should not be cached. Scripts and extensions that store the output of `gh auth token` will eventually hold an expired token, so run `gh auth token` again each time a token is needed. Tokens supplied through `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` are never refreshed.

## Manage issue artifacts with `gh issue artifact` (private preview)

`gh issue artifact` brings issue artifacts to the command line. Users and organizations enrolled in the private preview can use the `list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `download`, and `delete` commands to manage issue artifacts.

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

Artifacts can also be addressed by their GitHub URLs, and Markdown documents support image and video attachments with `--attach`.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Issue artifacts are in private preview. These commands only work for repositories enrolled in the preview. See the [Issue Artifacts private preview announcement and feedback discussion](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/205881) for access instructions and to share feedback.
